# magikAAAAArp Pong Texture Source

`magikaaaaaarp_album.jpg` is the source image used for the cube ball in
`game-magikaaaaaarp-pong`. It is magikAAAAArp's album artwork and is not
covered by this repository's GPL licence; see `THIRD_PARTY.md`.

`score_flyby.png` is the source image used for the score flyby gag. It keeps
transparent pixels outside the circular cutout.

The runtime embeds `../assets/magikaaaaaarp_album.psxt` and
`../assets/score_flyby.psxt`, cooked from these images by `make assets` in
[PSoXide-editor](https://github.com/EBonura/PSoXide-editor), where the game
lived before this collection was split out. This repository ships the cooked
files and does not re-cook them.

`../assets/goncharov_spectrum_16x30hz.bin` is a baked 16-band, 30 Hz spectrum
visualizer table, generated by `make magikaaaaaarp-pong-spectrum` in
PSoXide-editor. Goncharov is by
[magikAAAAArp](https://www.youtube.com/@magikAAAAArp/videos) and is used with
the band's permission.

The standalone disc's CD-DA track is `arcade-assets/audio/goncharov.cdda`
(the same bytes as PSoXide-editor's `assets/audio/cdda/GONCHAROV.track02.cdda`).
